spans.s: धि (1)a technical term used for sonant consonants in the Pratisakhya and old grammar works; cf. धि शेषः V. Pr.
, explained by Uvvata as वर्गाणां उत्तरास्त्रय: यरलवहकाराश्च धि: V.Pr.
; the term धि corresponds to हश् of Panini; (2) personal ending धि substituted for हि of the impera. 2nd sing. e.g. जुहुधि, छिन्द्धि, भिन्द्धि, श्रुधि, रारन्धि etc.; cf.
